title: Practice 5: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (навести / наводить — to introduce, bring, produce, make, cause; 1st sg.) на вас тоску.
exercises.why: **наведу** — future tense (1st person singular) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: В окружной центр Корчагин ___ (наезжать / наехать — to come in large numbers; past m. sg.) редко.
exercises.why: **наезжал** — past tense (masculine) of наезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: наехать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: ___ (налетать / налететь — to fly, to come flying; past f. sg.) банда на тихие волостные местечки.
exercises.why: **налетала** — past tense (feminine) of налетать: imperfective (perfective partner: налететь).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.why: **набежало** — past tense (neuter) of набежать: perfective (imperfective partner: набегать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: ___ (взойти / всходить — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; imper. 1st pl.) на эшафот, капитан!
exercises.why: **взойдёмте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of взойти: perfective (imperfective partner: всходить).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
